topRisks.title: Admin 2FA TOTP not enforced — Owner/Admin proxy is session-only
topRisks.why: Owner role bypasses all RBAC mitigations; PRD requires TOTP second factor enforced at proxy. Launching admin without this enables full account takeover of the commerce operator.

topRisks.title: Faceted SEO index rule missing — ≥2 facets not noindex,follow; pagination canonical drift
topRisks.why: PLP is top SEO surface. Without ≥2-facet noindex and correct pagination canonical, crawlers waste budget on combinatorial duplicates and incur duplicate-content penalty.

topRisks.title: Cart requestId dedupe is per-instance memory (Map) — duplicates under horizontal scale
topRisks.why: 5-min dedupe via Map works on single Vercel instance but fails under rolling deploy / autoscale; retry creates duplicate lines. Upgrade to cart_request_dedupe table with TTL sweep is v1.1.

topRisks.title: Relaxed facet counts not computed — no per-facet relaxed aggregation CTE
topRisks.why: Filter panel cannot show removal counts; violates §8.8 single round-trip no-N+1 contract and blocks PLP facet UX.

topRisks.title: No product_metrics materialized view — bestselling sort silently falls back to sort_order
topRisks.why: ?sort=bestselling lies to merchandising; PRD v1.1 contract requires 15-min refresh view. Acceptable fallback but must be explicit.

topRisks.title: Missing DB CHECK constraints — amount≥0, qty 1..99, rating 1..5, alt<>''
topRisks.why: App/Zod guards are bypassable via direct SQL/Drizzle. Negative amounts break pricing invariants (discount≤subtotal, largest-remainder).

topRisks.title: No updated_at $onUpdate trigger — optimistic concurrency depends on app memory
topRisks.why: Admin optimistic updatedAt check works but DDL should mirror it; cheap forward migration fixes stale-write window.

topRisks.title: CI builds but never deploys — no preview URL, no immutable tagged builds, no rollback
topRisks.why: start_server.sh kill+restart is only rollback. Without Vercel preview + tagged releases + artifact retention, every merge is untested in a prod-like URL and rollback is manual.

topRisks.title: DR unprovisioned — no PITR / 30-day snapshots / RTO 4h RPO 15m
topRisks.why: Intentionally Unverifiable from repo per §12.4 until managed PG. Not a Phase 0 gate failure but ops must materialize before Production exit.

topRisks.title: PDP cross-sell Pairs well with 4-up missing
topRisks.why: Curated + bestseller fallback not implemented; no data-loss, only upsell gap — P2.
